verdict.rationale: Angular Signals are documented as the core reactive state primitive (angular-docs-1) and are plain TS values/functions that can be exercised outside a component tree, and the CLI ships a dedicated `ng test` command for unit tests (angular-docs-11); community evidence also highlights Angular's traditional emphasis on testability via DI and test tooling (angular-comm-9). However, none of the evidence explicitly documents unit-testing signals/services in isolation without TestBed or DOM rendering. Missing for 10: explicit docs/examples showing signal/service unit tests that avoid component rendering, and independent hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
